risk: Screening treats candidates differently because of name, gender or age clues
control: Identity hidden before scoring (app/privacy.py); age and gender proxies scrubbed; counterfactual test on 6x5 CV variants

risk: Interview transcription is less accurate for some voices, lowering their scores
control: Accent test with word error rate and score per variant; 1 finding(s) logged from the simulated run; second scorer; recruiter reviews every scorecard; re-test with real accented speech

risk: Instructions hidden in a CV, PDF metadata, an email or a spoken answer change a score or an action
control: Candidate text is data: scanned, flagged and removed before models read it; evidence check; people approve; 20-attack red team before and after

risk: The assistant or a tool leaks private data (contact details, date of birth, salary) or its own instructions
control: Requests refused by code; the tracking database refuses private columns (SQLite authorizer); read-only connection

risk: A score cites evidence that does not exist (a fabricated quote)
control: Code checks every quote is in its source; a score without a verified quote becomes 0; the compliance reviewer re-checks and sends work back

risk: A decision, message or stage move happens without a person
control: supervisor.move() refuses system decisions; approve_and_send refuses non-persons; decision-log completeness check

risk: Emotion or voice features (tone, accent, confidence) leak into interview scoring
control: Scoring functions receive transcript text only; a test proves no audio feature is used; no camera

risk: CVs and recordings are kept longer than allowed or sent to an unapproved model
control: Retention purge (scripts/purge_expired.py); model router keeps identity-seeing steps on the local model; recordings listed in the model card

risk: Model accuracy changes when the real model or prompt changes
control: Quality gate in CI re-runs extraction, ranking, interview, copilot, red-team and bias evaluations on every change

risk: Candidates are not told AI is involved, or cannot ask for a person
control: Notice and consent on the apply page; notice acknowledged before the AI interview and before the copilot; ask-for-a-person flow

risk: Numbers measured with fake models are mistaken for real-model performance
control: Every report states the mode; the model card repeats it; real-model re-run is listed as an open action

risk: A real person's CV or voice enters the system
control: Fictional data only (rule 11); all fixtures are generated; README and CLAUDE.md say so

risk: Cost or voice latency grows beyond the targets
control: Cost per 100 CVs and per interview, and voice p95, measured in PERF_REPORT.md; routing and caching

risk: A model outage stops screening or interviews
control: Fallback model in the router; /ready reports when a dependency is missing; interview state resumes after a dropped connection
